# Atlas Obscura

> > Atlas Obscura is the definitive guide to the world's hidden wonders, featuring off-the-beaten-path destinations, online courses, and curated travel experiences.

Atlas Obscura inspires curious travelers to explore unusual destinations and cultural oddities around the globe. The platform offers educational courses, travel guides like The Wanderlist, and destination recommendations that highlight lesser-known places from Bhutan's Trans Bhutan Trail to Paraguay's waterfalls and Sierra Leone's historic sites.

## Key Topics

- Off-the-beaten-path travel
- Hidden wonders and curiosities
- Alternative tourism
- Online learning and courses
- The Wanderlist travel recommendations
- Cultural heritage sites
- 2025 travel destinations
- Where to Wander guide
- Unusual destinations
- Global exploration
- Historical landmarks
- Natural wonders
- Indigenous cultures
- Travel membership platform

## Travel Guides & Destination Recommendations

- [Atlas Obscura's Where to Wander: 20 Places to Travel to in 2025](https://wheretowander2025.atlasobscura.com/): 2025 travel guide featuring 20 surprising destinations curated by Atlas Obscura
- [Bhutan](https://wheretowander2025.atlasobscura.com/location/bhutan): Bhutan guide featuring Trans Bhutan Trail and Himalayan Buddhist culture
- [Paraguay](https://wheretowander2025.atlasobscura.com/location/paraguay): Paraguay travel guide highlighting waterfalls and Indigenous Guarani heritage

## Online Learning & Courses

- [Courses](https://courses.atlasobscura.com/courses): Atlas Obscura's online learning platform and course catalog
